name: Singapore

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, red over white, with a white crescent and a ring of five small white five-pointed stars in the upper hoist of the red band.
flag.symbolism: Red represents universal brotherhood and equality, white purity and virtue; the crescent stands for a young nation and the five stars for democracy, peace, progress, justice and equality.

hook: Singapore is red over white like Indonesia, but with a white crescent and five stars in the top-left corner.
trivia: The flag was adopted in 1959 when Singapore became self-governing and was kept at full independence in 1965.
Singapore is one of only a few city-states in the world, with the whole country governed as a single city.
